levels.surface: أبو الحسن علي بن محمد الكاتب
أبو عمرو حفص بن عمر الفرا

notes: «3 -» is the report number, left out

«سمعت أبا عبيد الله ... يحدث أبا جعفر» : Abu Ja'far is the one addressed and speaks only at the close as a comment on the transmitter; he is not added, and the last link is the Companion whose sermon is relayed
surfaces are kept in the case the text writes them («أبا عبيد الله», «أبا سعيد»)
